title: Backfill overview index from existing group_log on startup
description: On reader startup, scan group_log for articles not yet in the overview index and populate the missing entries by fetching their ArticleMetadata from IPFS. This handles articles that arrived via transit propagation rather than direct POST. Why: articles posted to transit peers before the reader started will be in the group_log but missing from the overview index; backfill ensures OVER is complete.
